name: YITA-100P-C
summary: An integrated robot joint module in YITA Dynamics’ C series, combining precision transmission, drive control and dual absolute-encoder feedback. This model has a 44 N·m rated torque, 220 N·m peak torque and 1.1 kg mass. It supports EtherCAT and CAN FD and includes a through-bore for routing.

description.en: An integrated robot joint module in YITA Dynamics’ C series, combining precision transmission, drive control and dual absolute-encoder feedback.
